content.short: World's First Interest-Free Stablecoin Protocol built on Cardano.
content.description: ADADAO is a DeFi protocol on Cardano blockchain which facilitates creation of fully collateralized stable coins leveraging Native Cardano Assets. We are starting with ADA tokens only but the governance can decide on addition of more assets as and when required. ADADAO functions as a DAO (Decentralized Autonomous Organization). AUSD is the stablecoin generated using this protocol. ADAO is the utility and governance token which allows users to decide how the protocol functions and also gives them a share of the fees raised through the protocol.
content.meta: Find out about ADADAO (ADAO) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
